methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from official vendor pricing pages where available. TechSmith (Camtasia, Snagit) and Movavi official pages returned EUR prices due to geo-IP routing; USD prices for Camtasia and Snagit sourced from GetApp and SoftwareAdvice aggregators (noted in provenance). Movavi excluded because no verified USD price could be found from any source. Vimeo annual-billing monthly rates corrected on verification to $12 (Starter) / $25 (Standard) / $75 (Advanced) per uscreen.tv and multiple aggregators; prior $13/$26/$76 figures were each $1 too high and were fixed. Camtasia Starter monthlyUsd set to null: Capterra describes a free watermarked tier but the official TechSmith page lists Starter as a paid ~EUR 39.57/year subscription, so the free claim could not be confirmed. Camtasia Pro ($499/yr), Snagit Individual ($39/yr) and Business ($48/yr), and Loom Business ($18 m2m / ~$15 annual) and Business+AI ($24 m2m / ~$20 annual) were independently confirmed and left unchanged. OBS Studio is free/open-source with no paid tiers. All prices are recurring monthly costs expressed as the annualized monthly rate where annual-only billing applies. accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources.

vendors.name: Loom
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page loom.com/pricing; confirmed by SoftwareAdvice aggregator.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 50 workspace members, 25 videos per person, 5-minute recording limit, 720p quality.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Month-to-month rate is $18/user/month. Annual billing saves 17% (~$15/user/month). Unlimited videos, 4K quality, basic editing, no Loom branding.

plans.name: Business + AI
plans.notes: Month-to-month rate is $24/user/month. Annual billing saves 17% (~$20/user/month). Includes AI features: auto-summaries, video enhancement, meeting recaps.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. SSO, SCIM, custom data retention, 99.95% uptime SLA.

vendors.name: Camtasia
vendors.provenance: Official TechSmith pricing page (techsmith.com/camtasia-pricing.html) returned EUR prices due to geo-IP; USD prices sourced from GetApp aggregator (getapp.com). Annual billing only; no monthly option available.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Entry-level tier. Aggregators (Capterra) describe a free watermarked tier, but the official TechSmith pricing page lists Starter as a paid subscription (~EUR 39.57/year). Because the free claim cannot be confirmed against the vendor's own page, monthlyUsd set to null pending clarification.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Annual-only billing at $179.88/user/year (~$14.99/month). No watermark. Screen and camera recording, video editing, speech-to-text.

plans.name: Create
plans.notes: Annual-only billing at $249/user/year (~$20.75/month). All Essentials features plus text-based video editing, AI script generation, audio cleanup, 200+ AI voices.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual-only billing at $499/user/year (~$41.58/month). All Create features plus video reviews, AI-translated captions, AI avatar generation, 100M+ premium assets.

vendors.name: ScreenPal
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page screenpal.com/plans. Annual rates confirmed; monthly rates from SoftwareAdvice aggregator (plan names differ slightly: Solo Deluxe = Deluxe, Solo Premier = Max).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. 15-minute recording cap, 10 hosted videos.

plans.name: Deluxe
plans.notes: Annual billing rate $4.00/month. Month-to-month option available at higher rate (~$5-6/month per aggregator). Unlimited recorder, host and share unlimited videos.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Annual billing rate $10.00/month. Includes ScreenPal AI, automated captions, premium stock assets.

plans.name: Max Team Business
plans.notes: Annual billing at $8/user/month (20% off Max). Minimum 3 creators. All Max features plus collaboration tools, team management, SSO/SAML.

vendors.name: Snagit
vendors.provenance: Official TechSmith pricing page (techsmith.com/snagit-pricing.html) returned EUR prices due to geo-IP. USD prices sourced from GetApp and SoftwareAdvice aggregators; both confirm Individual at $39/year. Business at $48/year per GetApp (SoftwareAdvice data entry appears to be a per-year figure mislabeled as per-month).

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Annual-only subscription at $39/user/year (~$3.25/month). Webcam recording, scrolling capture, annotation tools. Up to 25 videos on Screencast.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Annual-only subscription at $48/user/year (~$4.00/month). Transferable licenses, phone support, no end-user accounts required. Discount available for 10+ users.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Available for 100+ users.

vendors.name: Vimeo Record
vendors.provenance: Official Vimeo screen recorder page vimeo.com/features/screen-recorder. Screen recording is bundled into standard Vimeo plans; no standalone product pricing. Annual billing rates shown.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited screen recording included. 1GB storage, 1 seat.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually at $12/month ($20/month month-to-month). 100GB storage, 1 seat. Screen recording included.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually at $25/month ($41/month month-to-month). 5 seats, 2TB storage. Adds teleprompter and text-based editing.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Billed annually at $75/month ($125/month month-to-month). 10 seats, 7TB storage. Includes livestreaming and webinar hosting.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Advanced security, controls, and support.

vendors.name: OBS Studio
vendors.provenance: Official OBS Studio website obsproject.com. Free and open-source; no paid tiers exist.

plans.name: Free (Open Source)
plans.notes: Completely free and open-source. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux. Sustained by sponsorships from YouTube, Twitch, Logitech, NVIDIA, AMD. No paid tier exists.

vendors.name: Droplr
vendors.provenance: Official Droplr pricing page droplr.com/pricing. Confirmed by SoftwareAdvice aggregator. Monthly and annual rates verified from official page.

plans.name: Pro Plus
plans.notes: Annual billing at $6/month ($72/year). Month-to-month rate is $8/month. 100GB storage, 500GB/month bandwidth, unlimited screen recording and screenshots, annotation tools, video trimming.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Annual billing at $7/user/month ($84/user/year). Month-to-month rate is $9/user/month. Up to 15 members. Adds team analytics and viewer analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Request a quote. For teams 16+ members. Includes SSO, AI-powered auto-redaction, unlimited storage and bandwidth.

vendors.name: Bandicam
vendors.provenance: Official Bandicam store page bandicam.com/buy. USD prices confirmed directly from official page.

plans.name: Personal Annual (1-PC)

plans.name: Personal Perpetual (1-PC)
plans.notes: One-time purchase at $53.90 (30% off from $77.00). No recurring fee. Personal use only. One-time price recorded here; monthlyUsd is null as no subscription component exists.

plans.name: Business Annual (1-PC)
plans.notes: Annual subscription at $49.46/year (~$4.12/month, 25% off from $65.95). Transferable license for commercial use.
